messages:
Maya Chen: quick heads-up 1: I'm opening a DRAFT PR to unify Optimize heuristics: batching heuristics, cache defaults, and a small set of recommended quant profiles for common app patterns. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/492
Samir Patel: sweet. can we include a tiny before/after perf snapshot? ops wants a couple of numbers to cite.
Maya Chen: yes 1: planning a 3-row table (short chat <=64, mid chat <=512, long-form >=2k) with latency p95, tokens/sec, and estimated $/1k tokens.
Leo Grant: FYI a few docs still link to /console/v1/optimize. I'll grep and prepare redirects once the PR merges.
Anika Rao: please add an SDK snippet demonstrating KV prefetch + batching. that's our most-requested pattern from customers.
Maya Chen: adding brief Python and Go snippets. python preview: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
prompts = ["hello", "summarize: ..."]
resp = client.generate_batch(model="rwd-open-llama-q4", inputs=prompts, batch_size=8, prefetch_kv=True)
for r in resp: print(r.text)
```
Priya Singh: add a short caveat paragraph: prefetch can regress when prefix cardinality is high or requests are single-turn unique prompts.
Maya Chen: good call, adding that note with an example.
Samir Patel: CI flagged a broken link in heuristics.md. docs-bot, drop the failing job?
docs-bot: CI: docs-check #328 failed - https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/328 - markdown-link-check error at docs/optimize/heuristics.md: line 50 (link to /console/v1/optimize).
Leo Grant: I'll send a tiny PR to flip links to /console/v2 and add a redirect entry.
Anika Rao: batching recommendation: current doc suggests batch_size: 64 for short-chat. can we add an explicit heuristic: if median_tokens < 32 then batch_size = min(8 * concurrency, 64) and show worked example? makes it easier to apply.
Maya Chen: done, will include math and a step-by-step example for 16 concurrent workers.
Priya Singh: for quant profiles, can we organize them by tier: latency-sensitive, balanced, cost-opt? include key params (dtype, block_size/group, fallback) and map to model variants. PMs prefer that taxonomy.
Maya Chen: added: latency-sensitive -> int8+fp16 hybrid, balanced -> q4_0, cost-opt -> q4_1 + cache. mapped to model names in examples.
Samir Patel: also include a tiny migration checklist: q8 -> q4 mapping table and try `fallback_to_fp16: true` if you see quality drops.
Leo Grant: include a YAML route example for Dedicated customers showing per-route cache: ```yaml
routes:
  - name: assist
    model: rwd-open-llama-q4
    cache:
      prefix_ttl: 20s
      max_kv_entries: 2048
```
Maya Chen: adding. also writing a short A/B recipe for PMs: 1) snapshot eval set, 2) route 10% traffic to q4_1 for 48h, 3) run automated evals + human checks, 4) rollback if quality delta exceeds threshold.
Priya Singh: can you include the eval metric suggestions (ROUGE for summarization, BLEU for translations, logprob delta for chat)?
Maya Chen: yes, adding suggested thresholds and sample eval queries.
Anika Rao: small troubleshooting FAQ please: "Why didn't my batch form?" - mention cross-client batching limitations, token oversize, and per-request max_batch_size.
Maya Chen: FAQ added. also including a monitoring one-liner: watch per-route tokens/sec, p95 latency, and cache hit ratio. sample alert rule included.
Samir Patel: after merge let's extract SDK snippets into the examples repo so CI lints them.
Maya Chen: agreed 1: I'll open a follow-up issue to move snippets to /examples and add a snippet test.
Leo Grant: one more: SVG image still references /console/v1 in assets. I'll fix that in a separate PR.
Maya Chen: thanks all. aiming to move DRAFT -> ready by EOD tomorrow. reviewers?
Samir Patel: I'll review perf numbers + quant text.
Leo Grant: I'll own link changes + assets.
Anika Rao: I'll review SDK snippets and FAQ.
Priya Singh: I'll sanity-check the A/B guidance and thresholds.
Maya Chen: thanks team 1: I'll ping when it's ready for review. :thumbsup:
